Title: Azure Backup locally redundant storage (LRS) and geo-redundant storage (GRS) data stored meter ID changes

Body.Content:
Effective September 1, 2020, the meter IDs of Azure Backup—LRS and GRS data stored will change in the ZA West and ZA North regions.  

There won't be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on resource GUIDs.
